{{Quote|It's a trap! We'll have to finish Valorum in person!|Zegmon Pent|<ref name="Shadows" />}}
'''Zegmon Pent''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] leader, [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], and false [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] claimant.

==Biography==
Zegmon Pent began his career as a smuggler with political convictions. At some point, he joined the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization known as [[The Flail]]. The Flail believed that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was corrupt, and they attacked public services in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], destroying properties and caring little for lives. Many members of The Flail, including Pent, were fanatically loyal to the cause and ready to sacrifice their own lives to fulfill a goal.<ref name="Shadows" />

At some point before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Zegmon Pent stole an imitation [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] had experimentally built. The edge would shut down automatically if in contact with an energy weapon or blast, but Pent intended to use it only for intimidation purposes. Pent falsely maintained that he had been trained as a "secret [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]" by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and hinted that he had [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers. The Flail unquestioningly believed his claims.<ref name="Shadows" />

[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] began a personal crusade against The Flail, damaging the organization. Valorum's agents killed all the leaders of The Flail. Pent took advantage of this situation and became the new leader of The Flail. He organized meetings in an empty warehouse, but he only went there for the meetings; his subordinates did not know how to contact him. Pent also made communiques to the news, suggesting that he was a Jedi.<ref name="Shadows" />

Valorum publicly promised to bring the remnants of the Flail to justice before the following Senate hearing. The Flail answered by threatening Valorum. Pent then organized a triple attempt against Valorum's life, to take place during the politician's next public speech. Demolition expert [[Senn Riip Domeet]] was sent in disguise to hide an explosive device under Valorum's platform, but his work could have been discovered. Pent also wrote a computer program that would override the current instructions in the [[Weather Modulation Control Center]] to unleash a thunderstorm that could damage the buildings around the speech area; five terrorists were sent to the Control Center to load the software, but some new agents of Valorum stopped them.<ref name="Shadows" />

Valorum then went personally, with seven other men, to the [[Air Traffic Control|Traffic Control Center]] only ten minutes before the speech. They intended to load a vehicle with explosives and remote-pilot it to make it crash with the platform. However, they met the new agents, who had discovered Pent's plan, and were forced to fight with them. Pent and his men were defeated, and the Chancellor finished his speech alive.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Personality and traits==
Pent favored black and yellow robes, with his imitation lightsaber commonly hanging from his belt. Pent was a zealot, ready to die if he could kill the Supreme Chancellor or at least destroy his career while doing so.<ref name="Shadows" />
